description: Bahnhöfe im Saarland is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Total stations in Saarland: The survey covers all stations and stops in Saarland. The dataset also includes the museum routes with stations, stops and owners. You will find a link in the Access section, where you can read the categories of stations according to DB Group classification. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Railway stations in Saarland" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Saarland, geoportal, Verkehrswesen_Bahnhoefe, Verkehrswesen. The listing shows 2022-05-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
